title: Society campaigns
description: Planned recyclable collection drives for residential societies and neighbourhoods.
details: Bring a whole community’s sorted scrap into one organised collection. Plan the location, material mix and a convenient collection window with the society coordinator.
scope: Household paper, cardboard, plastic and separated metals
Collection point and resident coordination
One-time drives or an agreed recurring schedule
prepare: Society name, locality and coordinator details
Approximate participating homes and material quantities
Space for collection and vehicle access

title: Vehicle scrapping services
description: Vehicle valuation, collection planning and paperwork coordination for old vehicles.
details: Plan the next step for an old vehicle with the condition, ownership details and collection access reviewed together. The published four-wheeler rate uses weight; the final valuation and paperwork scope are agreed before collection.
scope: Vehicle condition and valuation review
Loading and pickup access planning
Scrapping paperwork coordination within the agreed scope
prepare: Vehicle type, condition and approximate location
Ownership and vehicle documents available for review
Whether the vehicle can move and how it can be accessed

title: Paper shredding services
description: Scheduled shredding for confidential paper and records, with destruction documentation arranged in the service scope.
details: Keep sensitive records separate from ordinary paper scrap. We plan the quantity, handling, shredding arrangement and destruction documentation before the service.
scope: Confidential paper and record-clearing enquiries
Handling and shredding schedule
Destruction record or certificate as agreed for the service
prepare: Approximate volume or weight of records
Any custody, witnessing or access requirements
Required destruction documentation and preferred schedule

title: Industrial & corporate e-waste disposal
description: Organised collection enquiries for bulk electronics from factories, IT parks and offices.
details: Share an asset list so equipment type, condition, quantity, data-handling instructions and pickup logistics can be reviewed before a bulk collection is agreed.
scope: Computers, monitors, printers, UPS and related equipment
Bulk inventory and pickup planning
Data-handling and documentation requirements agreed before collection
prepare: An item-wise equipment list and quantities
Data-handling instructions from the asset owner
Loading access, floor and lift details

title: Door to door pickup
description: A convenient pickup request for sorted household scrap, starting in Baripada.
details: Make a little more room at home. Select your materials, share the locality and choose a preferred day. The final pickup window is confirmed before collection.
scope: Paper, cardboard, plastic, reusable clothes and separated metals
Material-wise weighing and rate discussion
A preferred day followed by pickup confirmation
prepare: Keep paper dry and flatten cardboard
Separate materials and safely pack glass
Share floor, lift and access details

title: Packaging industry scrap
description: Collection planning for corrugated boxes, kraft and separated packaging offcuts.
details: Keep production and packaging areas clearer with an agreed collection plan for separated kraft, corrugated boxes and suitable packaging material.
scope: Corrugated boxes and kraft waste
Separated packaging production offcuts
One-time clearances or planned repeat collections
prepare: Material grades and approximate weights
Loose, flattened or baled condition
Storage location and loading access

title: Construction site scrap
description: Separated metal, pipe offcuts, wire and suitable packaging scrap from worksites.
details: Describe the material and site access so collection can be planned around the work area. Heavy or awkward pieces need a separately agreed loading arrangement.
scope: Metal and GI pipe offcuts
Copper or aluminium wire and suitable PVC scrap
Separated kraft and packaging waste
prepare: Material-wise quantities and photographs if available
Site entry instructions and loading arrangements
Any restricted access or lifting needs

title: IT companies scrap
description: Planned clearances of old computers, monitors, printers, servers, UPS and related equipment.
details: Keep an item-wise equipment list ready and identify any data-bearing assets. Agree the handling instructions and collection plan before the equipment leaves your premises.
scope: Desktop towers, monitors, printers and UPS
Related office electronics and mixed equipment enquiries
One-time or scheduled asset clearances
prepare: Equipment list, quantities and condition
Asset ownership and data-handling instructions
Floor, lift and vehicle access

title: College & institution scrap
description: Collection enquiries for journals, assignments, answer sheets and other institutional paper waste.
details: Plan a clearance around your academic schedule. Separate ordinary recyclable paper from confidential records that need a dedicated shredding arrangement.
scope: Old journals, assignments and answer sheets
Books and separated paper waste
Campus collection coordination
prepare: Approximate paper volumes and storage locations
Whether records require confidential destruction
Campus access and preferred collection dates

title: Printing press scrap
description: Sorted paper offcuts, book cutting, LCC, rim cutting, newsprint and wrapper waste.
details: Keep production offcuts separated by grade so quantities and rates can be discussed clearly. Share the material mix, storage condition and expected collection frequency.
scope: Book cutting, LCC and rim cutting enquiries
Newsprint and wrapper waste
Separated paper and kraft grades
prepare: The paper grades and approximate weights
Loose or baled storage condition
Production schedule and loading access

title: Society redevelopment scrap
description: Clearance planning for doors, window sections, grills, taps, wiring and other recoverable material.
details: Organise material recovery during a society redevelopment or renovation. List the items, dismantling status and access needs so removal and loading can be planned before work begins.

Taps, wiring and other separated material
Removal and loading scope agreed before collection
prepare: Item list and approximate quantities
Whether items are dismantled and safe to move

title: Bank / office scrap
description: Paper, fixtures and equipment clearances, with confidential document handling arranged separately.
details: Plan an office clean-out with paper, fixtures and electronics listed separately. Sensitive records need an agreed handling and shredding scope before collection.

Office metal fixtures and equipment enquiries
Document shredding coordination within the agreed scope
prepare: Material and equipment inventory
Confidentiality and destruction requirements
Building access, floors and preferred schedule
